name.zh: SuperPoD Flex / UBL128（128 NPU，单层 UB 交换）
name.en: SuperPoD Flex / UBL128 (128 NPUs, single-layer UB switch)

name.zh: 4 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 4 × 200G（主算例）
name.en: 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 × 200G per NPU (main case)

basis.zh: HC2026：昇腾 960 超节点集群两层 Clos、四平面；星河 UBG 交换机 radix 最高 1,024；附件把它用于 950；950 白皮书允许 2 × 400G UBoE 拆成 4 × 200G
basis.en: HC2026: Ascend 960 SuperPoD clusters use a two-tier, four-plane Clos; Xinghe UBG switches have radix up to 1,024; the attachments apply this to 950; the 950 white paper lets the 2 × 400G UBoE split into 4 × 200G

basis.zh: 950 白皮书 2 × 400G UBoE，每口一个平面
basis.en: 950 white paper 2 × 400G UBoE, one plane per port

name.zh: 2 平面 × 三层，radix 128（51.2T），每 NPU 2 × 400G（HAC-D 模板默认）
name.en: 2 planes × 3 tiers, radix 128 (51.2T), 2 × 400G per NPU (HAC-D template default)

basis.zh: HAC-D a950-ub2 模板默认（综述 2.6 节）；交换机数与券商 UBoE 约 39,000 台同量级
basis.en: HAC-D a950-ub2 template default (survey §2.6); switch count of the order of the broker figure for UBoE (≈ 39,000)

name.zh: 附件方案：每 NPU 1 × 800G，按轨分到 4 个平面，radix 128，按 Clos 自洽所需层数
name.en: the attachments’ scheme: 1 × 800G per NPU, rails spread over 4 planes, radix 128, as many tiers as a Clos needs

basis.zh: 附件写作“两层四平面”、64 口叶 + 128 口脊；每平面 12.8 万个端点时两层 radix 128 只能接 64 × 128 = 8,192 个，须三层
basis.en: the attachments call it “two tiers, four planes” with 64-port leaves and 128-port spines; with 128,000 endpoints per plane two tiers of radix 128 reach only 64 × 128 = 8,192, so three tiers are needed

name.zh: 主算例 + 叶层 2:1 收敛
name.en: main case with 2:1 at the leaves

basis.zh: 附件架构五（推理 PD 分离）的 2:1 收敛，仅作对照
basis.en: the 2:1 of the attachments’ architecture 5 (inference PD disaggregation), for comparison only

superpod.source: Huawei Computing 2026-09-30 (SuperPoD Flex / UBL128, jointly defined with DeepSeek): 128 NPUs on a single layer of UB switching at 3.2 Tb/s per NPU, two-tier scale-out to 256K NPUs

superpod.computeRacks.source: 2 compute cabinets of 64 NPUs per pod (Atlas 950 cabinet)

superpod.commRacks.source: one switch cabinet per pod in the geometry; counted as one per 4 pods through countOverrides.commCabinet

superpod.rackSwitches.source: all NPUs on the single switch layer: no in-cabinet switches

superpod.podUplinksPerNpu.source: Huawei Computing 2026-09-30: 3.2 Tb/s UB bandwidth per NPU on a single switching layer → 4 × 800G links

superpod.podSwitchRadix.source: the Atlas 950 pod-tier switch (128 × 800G, Hot Chips 2025) assumed for the UBL128 single layer; 128 NPUs × 4 uplinks / 128 ports = 4 switches per pod
superpod.podSwitchRadix.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was derived; the switch model of the UBL128 layer is not public, only the count follows from the assumed radix

countOverrides.commCabinet.source: one switch cabinet per 4 pods (the attached report's 1,000 cabinets for 4,000 pods)

countOverrides.ubMeshLink.source: tray mesh only: 28 electrical links per 8-NPU tray, no cabinet-wide mesh

scaleOut.source: bandwidth per NPU: Atlas 950 white paper 2 × 400G UBoE, splittable into 4 × 200G (vendor); planes / tiers / radix: by analogy with the Ascend 960 SuperPoD cluster (HC2026) as the attachments apply it; Huawei Computing 2026-09-30 states two-tier scale-out to 256K NPUs
scaleOut.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was derived; the network design is an analogy, the two-tier statement and the per-NPU bandwidth are vendor values

assumed.zh: 每超节点 2 个 64 卡计算柜（Atlas 950 柜）
assumed.en: 2 compute cabinets of 64 NPUs per pod (the Atlas 950 cabinet)

assumed.zh: 每 NPU 4 × 800G 上联 = 厂商的 3.2 Tb/s；交换 128 × 800G（沿用 950 的交换芯片）→ 每超节点 4 台
assumed.en: 4 × 800G uplinks per NPU = the vendor’s 3.2 Tb/s; 128 × 800G switches (the 950 pod switch assumed) → 4 per pod

assumed.zh: 无柜内 LRS：全部 NPU 接单层交换；每 8 卡托盘 28 条电链路，无柜级全互联
assumed.en: no in-cabinet LRS: every NPU on the single switching layer; 28 electrical links per 8-NPU tray, no cabinet-wide mesh

assumed.zh: 每 4 个超节点 1 个交换柜（附件报告：4,000 超节点 1,000 柜）
assumed.en: one switch cabinet per 4 pods (the attached report’s 1,000 cabinets for 4,000 pods)

assumed.zh: 每节点 2 CPU；每条光链路 2 只光模块
assumed.en: 2 CPUs per node; 2 transceivers per optical link

assumed.zh: scale-out 主设计 4 平面 × 两层、radix 1,024、每 NPU 4 × 200G：按 960 超节点集群（HC2026）类比；950 白皮书的 2 × 400G UBoE 可拆为 4 × 200G，带宽为厂商值
assumed.en: scale-out main design 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 × 200G per NPU: by analogy with the 960 SuperPoD cluster (HC2026); the 950 white paper’s 2 × 400G UBoE split into 4 × 200G, the bandwidth is the vendor value

ubLabel.zh: 单层 UB 交换（每 NPU 4 × 800G）+ 光链路
ubLabel.en: single-layer UB switching (4 × 800G per NPU) + optics

podLabel.zh: 超节点 128 NPU：2 计算柜 + 共享交换柜
podLabel.en: SuperPoD 128 NPUs: 2 compute cabinets + shared switch cabinet
